blocks.title: Predict: model one-triangle applications with SOH-CAH-TOA
content: What must be labeled before selecting a trig ratio?
instructor_notes: Require an individual prediction before discussion.

blocks.title: model one-triangle applications with SOH-CAH-TOA
content: Read, draw, label, choose a ratio, solve, and check.
Inverse trig finds an angle from a ratio.

blocks.title: Model the Skill: model one-triangle applications with SOH-CAH-TOA
content: A 20 ft ladder makes a $65^\circ$ angle with the ground. Find the height.
$\sin65^\circ=h/20$.
$h=20\sin65^\circ\approx18.13$ ft.
The result agrees with the corrected diagram and is less than 20 ft.
verification: Verify all one-triangle results and degree-mode instructions.
steps: The result agrees with the corrected diagram and is less than 20 ft.

assets.alt: Right triangle ladder diagram with a 20 foot ladder and 65 degree ground angle

blocks.title: Check and Diagnose: model one-triangle applications with SOH-CAH-TOA

A leg must be shorter than the hypotenuse.
instructor_notes: Ask students to explain why the incorrect path fails.

blocks.title: Predict: apply elevation, depression, and motion components
content: Why are an angle of depression and its matching angle of elevation equal?
instructor_notes: Require an individual prediction before discussion.

blocks.title: apply elevation, depression, and motion components
content: Both are measured from parallel horizontal lines.
Resolve motion with $d_x=d\cos\theta$ and $d_y=d\sin\theta$.

blocks.title: Model the Skill: apply elevation, depression, and motion components
content: A vehicle travels 300 miles at $25^\circ$ north of east. Resolve its displacement.

blocks.title: You Try: apply elevation, depression, and motion components
content: A vehicle travels 300 miles at 25° north of east. Find east and north components.

blocks.title: Check and Diagnose: apply elevation, depression, and motion components
content: Angles are measured from horizontal unless stated otherwise.
Use total distance before resolving components.
instructor_notes: Ask students to explain why the incorrect path fails.

blocks.title: Predict: solve complete and two-triangle application problems
content: What information is shared by two right triangles aimed at the same height?
instructor_notes: Require an individual prediction before discussion.

blocks.title: solve complete and two-triangle application problems
content: To solve a right triangle, find all missing sides and angles.
Two-triangle problems share a height and use related horizontal distances.

blocks.title: Model the Skill: solve complete and two-triangle application problems
content: Two tower observations are 50 ft apart with elevation angles $53^\circ$ and $31^\circ$. Find the closer distance d and height h.
verification: Verify complete-triangle and two-triangle algebra and units.
steps: Using the farther distance $91.37$ ft reproduces the same height.

blocks.title: You Try: solve complete and two-triangle application problems
content: Set up, but do not immediately solve, a two-observation tower problem with a 50 ft gap.

blocks.title: Check and Diagnose: solve complete and two-triangle application problems

Show the algebraic distribution step before dividing.
